narration: Here's a money trick that takes under two minutes and works nine times out of ten. Most people overpay their bills for years — just because they never asked.
visual: Animated phone SVG in center with dollar signs floating upward around it, large '$1,400/YEAR' stat text spring-animating in at bottom

narration: Every cable company, internet provider, and gym has a secret retention department. Their only job is to keep you — and they can cut your bill by up to forty percent.
visual: Person silhouette with headset at desk, 'RETENTION DEPT' badge appearing with spring animation, counter rising to show 40% discount available

narration: Number one: cable and internet. Number two: insurance. Number three: gym memberships. Those three bills alone could save you eight hundred dollars this year.
visual: Three icons spring in with staggered timing: cable box icon, shield icon, barbell icon — each with label and yearly savings amount beneath

narration: The script is dead simple. Just say 'I love the service, but I need to lower my bills.' That phrase gets the discount department on the phone every single time.
visual: Large speech bubble with the script phrase inside, phone handset SVG, '9 OUT OF 10' success badge appearing

narration: Medical bills are your biggest win. Eighty percent have billing errors, and hospitals expect negotiation. Just ask for the itemized bill and a cash-pay rate.
visual: Hospital bill/document SVG with red X marks and green checkmarks appearing on line items to show errors found, '80%' large stat text

narration: Pick one bill today and make the two-minute call. That's it. Five minutes of uncomfortable conversation could put fourteen hundred dollars back in your pocket this year.
